query: AWS AI contribution triple digit growth Q2 2026 annual revenue run rate $25 billion
normalized: 2026 25 ai annual aws billion contribution digit growth q2 rate revenue run triple

output.content:
Yes—Amazon said in its Q2 2026 earnings commentary that AWS’s AI revenue run rate had surpassed **$25 billion annually** and was growing at **triple-digit year-over-year percentages**. [[1]] 

Do not confuse that AI figure with total AWS revenue: AWS itself was operating at a **$169 billion annualized revenue run rate** at the time. [[1]]

sources.title: Q2 earnings: CEO Andy Jassy on why AWS is booming and what it means for customers
